valley_figure_issue.finding: Allowable rainfall appears to increase with catchment area for fixed width, contrary to physical capacity monotonicity.
valley_figure_issue.source_folder_check: No applicable correction located in the supplied standards folder; 2018 and 2021 sources contain the small-catchment table without this graph.
valley_figure_issue.implementation: Automatic selection above 20 m2 is rejected; the verified table and separate hydraulic diagnostics remain available.

appendix_h_review.method: Conservative bounded sampled envelopes; explicit Appendix I anchors remain distinct.
appendix_h_review.h1: Upper flow and narrower width; unadjusted depth retained without gradient reduction.
appendix_h_review.h3: Actual named pipe family for water depth; adopted hr and upper ha curve for length.
appendix_h_review.h4: Whole-flow samples restricted inside plotted family extents. Additional 20 mm visual-reading allowance. Independent Q7 review identified raw 100x75 and circular 100 underreads; regression lower bounds are 250 and 235 mm.
appendix_h_review.h6_h8: Adverse flow/width brackets with disclosed allowances; reviewed edge underreads corrected.
appendix_h_review.h5: Sump along-gutter dimension max(400, overflow width + twice offset); transverse dimension equals gutter width.
appendix_h_review.h7: Signed sump datum is 60 mm minus offset when offset exceeds 60 mm.
appendix_h_review.precision_limit: Sparse visual envelopes, not exact digitization; unsupported context requires a sourced designer reading.
